circle1_genius_strengths.point: Enterprise labor scheduling (incl. Fair Workweek compliance US/CA), inventory "down to the ounce," KPI dashboards, Mobile Manager app; POS/hardware-agnostic; Sysco and US Foods supplier integrations; Data Stream add-on for BI export
POS-agnostic claim widens addressable market beyond Genius POS

circle3_competitor_weaknesses.point: TransAct's FY2025 10-K names its direct competitors for the BOHA! foodservice/food-safety platform as Crunchtime Information Systems (including its Zenput and Squadle brands), Digi International, Avery Dennison, Ecolab, ITD Food Safety, Daymark Safety Systems, Integrated Control Corp, and Toast, Inc.
